data.title: Iran launches retaliatory strikes against US bases in Middle East | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Explosions heard in Eilat as sirens sound in southern Jordan following Iranian attacks. Iranian military spokesperson Ebrahim Zolfaghari stated that Iran “will no longer exercise restraint."
